text:
mira (PM): Starting a short thread to lock MVP for Optimize Toolkit: batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. Need owners and minimal launch gates.

diego (Eng): MVP proposal: Recommendations API + opt-in flag, lightweight decision path (p95 <=50ms), and canary rollback hook. Blockers: cache invalidation and variant routing.

anya (ML): Eval signals: concordance drop, perplexity spike, hallucination score. Default threshold 93% concordance, tenant-overridable. I'll produce a small nightly harness.

jordan (Solutions): Customers want per-tenant opt-in, audit trail, and a one-line rationale for recommendations (e.g. "save ~2x cost, concordance -4%"). Add two sample curl commands for SEs.

lee (SRE): Ops asks: 5% canary, automated rollback if fallback >5% for 10m, logs retention 90d, kill-switch env var. Also want a staging smoke test to run the eval harness.

pat (ProductOps): I'll own runbook + comms. Rollout plan: alpha opt-in -> 5% canary -> 25% -> GA. I'll schedule a 30m sync and collect acceptance criteria into a PR.

mira (PM): Owners recap: Diego = eng + perf, Anya = eval harness, Lee = rollback automation, Pat = runbook/comms, Jordan = SE materials. Action: Diego to drop RFC with API shape by Wed; Anya to share baseline numbers. Keep updates here. Thanks!
